title: Public educational/portfolio repository preparation

authorization.user_request: Mamdouh explicitly requested creation of a GitHub repository, publication for education/portfolio, environment setup material, database material, and an open license.
authorization.safe_interpretation: Publish only safe environment templates and database schema/migrations/demo infrastructure; never publish real environment values, credentials, tokens, database dumps, or operational data.
authorization.publication_target: GitHub public repository MamdouhAlsaodi/EstateFlow after independent staged-content audit.

objective: Prepare a public-safe repository surface that accurately presents EstateFlow as an in-progress Arabic-first Training Demo and teaches local setup without disclosing secrets or operational data.
forbidden: No git init, commit, remote, push, GitHub API/CLI call, publication, deployment, or release; Yui performs those only after independent audit.
No source app/business behavior, dependencies, lockfile, migration/schema, compose, CI, or test change.
Never add an actual .env file, credentials, token, private key, database URL with real password, database dump, SQLite file, production data, IP/hostname topology, or user/customer data.
Do not claim production readiness, hosted availability, completed Auth domain, or active CI run.

requirements.license: Create MIT License with copyright holder Mamdouh Alsaodi and current year 2026.
requirements.env_template: Retain only named placeholder variables, grouped and commented; use values such as YOUR_LOCAL_DATABASE_URL, YOUR_LOCAL_SESSION_SECRET, and YOUR_LOCAL_TOKEN_SECRET. Never include a concrete credential, IP address, port, or connection string.
requirements.database_material: Document that public database material is Prisma schema, versioned migrations, PostGIS initialization, and isolated local/test compose templates only. Explicitly state that no database dump, volume, operational record, or real data is included.
requirements.readme: Update stale progress to EF-101 through EF-107 completed/verified, state next planned task EF-120 but not started, include safe local quick-start, test/integration safety boundary, architecture overview, portfolio learning evidence, open-source license, and no-secrets/no-data policy.
requirements.security: Add SECURITY.md with responsible disclosure instruction using GitHub private security advisory; state not to open public issues containing credentials or customer data.
requirements.public_doc: Add docs/PUBLIC_REPOSITORY.md with explicit included/excluded inventory, setup variables policy, and publishing-audit checklist.

tdd_and_validation: Write no application test; this is documentation/configuration-only. First inspect existing public files and record defects: stale README, concrete-looking env example, missing license/security/public guide.

Use a deterministic local checks command that confirms env placeholders only, ignores actual .env and *.db, verifies MIT and required README/security statements, and confirms no forbidden literal appears in the edited public-facing files.
Run pnpm lint, typecheck, test, build, and format:check after edits; do not run Docker or integration tests.
acceptance: MIT LICENSE exists and is complete.
.env.example is demonstrably placeholders-only, while .gitignore rejects .env variants and *.db but permits .env.example.
README accurately describes current verified state and safe local database materials without external credentials or claims of publication/runtime availability.
SECURITY.md and public-repository guide define safe disclosure and exact publish boundary.
No source/dependency/database/compose changes and no Git/GitHub side effects occur in this worker task.
Worker report records scope and evidence for independent audit.
